dialogues.speaker: Higuchi Tetsuya
dialogues.text: I must do whatever it takes to finish "Tales of One Hundred Youkai." I promised my readers I would — on my dignity as a youkai novel writer, no less!

dialogues.speaker: Higuchi Tetsuya
dialogues.text: But I've told tales about tengu, and I've talked of bake-danuki... How the heck will I get to one hundred different types!? Youkai are what I need, and fresh ones, new ones!
